note: Revised per owner direction. Sol implements bounded branches; orchestrator reviews/tests. Local GitHub CLI authentication works on the restored Mac, and the full local gate including native tests and live acceptance passed September 14. See implementation-status.md for publishing evidence. Planned/local work is not a merged or released feature.

tasks.title: Prove the production API and durable storage
tasks.acceptance: Read required sibling Lesto guides, record the runtime ADR, serve real API routes over HTTPS with dev sign-in disabled, run migrations, and demonstrate backup restoration, health monitoring and deployment rollback. Verify request-path/token redaction at every serving/logging/tracing tier.

tasks.title: Implement verified adult authentication
tasks.acceptance: Implement server-verified Apple identity and verified email onboarding including verified sender and authentication-mail transport, durable provider-subject identity links, secure session lifecycle, revocation and sign-out. Product invitation/reminder delivery is SD-008; authentication must not depend on it. Production must reject fixed development personas and invalid nonce/audience/signature/replayed credentials.

tasks.title: Unify scoped permissions and private roster responses
tasks.acceptance: Use one policy for owner/coach/guardian/member; ordinary members cannot read other children's birth dates or private guardian data. Test cross-team, cross-season, revoked membership and own-child boundaries at API and HTML read paths.
tasks.note: Field-level roster response slice implemented and tested locally on codex/roster-privacy (40ddb487, 7f72703d), integrated as 594aa29 and 2d0ed0b. Not published or merged remotely. Unified runtime capability policy and co-coach delegation remain planned; full task is incomplete.

tasks.title: Secure guardian invitations and identity linking
tasks.acceptance: Bind elevated/guardian invitations to verified intended recipients or explicit manager confirmation. Test forwarded links, expiration, rotation, replay, Apple relay addresses and duplicate identities without relying on display names.

tasks.title: Add real launch, session and team selection
tasks.acceptance: Ship an explicit HTTPS staging/release configuration, real sign-in and returning-session behavior, logout, team/season switching and honest empty/error states. Release never falls back to preview success or dev sign-in.

tasks.title: Establish macOS tests, signing and internal archive
tasks.acceptance: Verify Apple app/team/bundle identifiers through authorized account setup, provide icon and capabilities, run Swift/live tests with nonzero test counts on Xcode 26+, archive a signed Release build and install internally with synthetic data. Preserve dSYMs and commit/build evidence.

tasks.title: Persist jobs, audit and delivery outbox
tasks.acceptance: Persist side effects in the same transaction as source mutations; implement retries, idempotency, cancellation, dead-letter/reconciliation and permission rechecks. A crash between commit and delivery must not lose an invitation/reminder.

tasks.title: Deliver invitations, email and APNs
tasks.acceptance: Use verified sender and production APNs credentials; implement device registration/revocation, generic previews, preferences, quiet hours, deep links and visible delivery failures. Verify real delivery on two devices without logging tokens or child data.

tasks.title: Complete team onboarding and roster UI
tasks.acceptance: Coach creates team/season and reviews roster CSV; invited parent joins correct team and child; second guardian and multi-team flows work. Browser invite handoff retains intended action across sign-in.

tasks.title: Complete schedule, RSVP and calendar subscription
tasks.acceptance: List and edit permitted events, preserve recurrence/DST/cancellations, RSVP only for authorized children and expose revocable one-way feed. Prove actual API logs/traces hide feed secrets; omit unsafe free-text feed fields. Test calendar re-import/update behavior.

tasks.title: Implement snack duties and swaps
tasks.acceptance: Persist event-linked slots, assignment/claim/release/swap states and due reminders. Concurrent claims cannot overfill capacity; event cancellation/reschedule invalidates stale reminders; parent confirms own responsibility.
tasks.note: Initial server-side slot/claim/release/assignment slice implemented and tested locally on codex/snack-duty-api (43fedeae), integrated as 41def6a. Not published or merged remotely. Native UI, swap, rotation, durable retry keys and reminders remain planned; full task is incomplete.

tasks.title: Ship minimal channels and threaded chat
tasks.acceptance: Implement announcements, team chat and staff visibility; threaded replies, paging, unread state, idempotent sends, reconnect catch-up and linked event/duty cards. No custom agent execution yet; permissions apply to every message read and mutation.

tasks.title: Add privacy, deletion and chat moderation
tasks.acceptance: Ship report/block/filtering and support response flow, in-app account deletion, retention/export and consent controls. Define how deletion affects shared records and legally retained evidence. Review privacy/age rating and verify no sensitive analytics or push payloads.

tasks.title: Release the owner's independent-team TestFlight beta
tasks.acceptance: Archive/upload the completed R1 commit and verify that exact build on physical devices: coach creates independent team → co-coach joins → parent accepts correct child link → event RSVP → duty claim → reminder → threaded reply. The same adult works as coach and parent without a second account. Unrelated team remains inaccessible. Complete external beta review before pilot invitations.

tasks.title: Add scoped agent proposals and execution
tasks.acceptance: Implement thread-scoped bot installation, typed tools, immutable proposal revisions, bound approvals, execution-time authorization, cost limits and audit results. Test prompt injection, stale approval, revoked role and cross-team retrieval.

tasks.title: Build league-email and attachment import proof
tasks.acceptance: Accept deliberate forwarding/upload; validate attachments and extract to reviewed roster/schedule drafts with source references. Reuse CSV import service; ambiguous records require correction and duplicate emails cannot duplicate people/invitations.

tasks.title: Deliver approved form templates and signing envelopes
tasks.acceptance: Obtain league/insurer template and acceptance requirements, evaluate embedded signing provider, persist versioned private documents, parent authority/consent/signature evidence and final hashes. Never expose answers through channel membership or let a bot sign.

tasks.title: Deliver parent signing and authorized coach packet
tasks.acceptance: Parent reviews and signs own child's request, resumes interrupted flow and receives a copy. Authorized coach sees completion/allowed documents, dated protected offline packet and printable export. Explain offline revocation/freshness limits.

tasks.title: Automate the coach's team readiness and reminders
tasks.acceptance: Agent drafts coverage and completion actions from authoritative records; configured reminders run automatically with cancellation and recipient checks. Measure admin correction rate and time saved; report failed/pending outcomes honestly.

tasks.title: Prepare Gmail verification and assessment
tasks.acceptance: Start in parallel with R0: confirm owned domain, scopes, consent/data inventory, privacy policy, verification video, processing terms and assessor quote. Record actual Google review status; do not treat Testing tokens as production access.

tasks.title: Implement verified Gmail incremental ingestion
tasks.acceptance: Gate rollout on applicable verification. Encrypt OAuth tokens, bind connection ownership, select sources/lookback, renew Pub/Sub watches, persist history cursors, reconcile gaps and duplicates, and support revocation/deletion. Filters do not misrepresent OAuth scope.

tasks.title: Add dedicated Google calendar integration
tasks.acceptance: Prefer app-created calendar scope; persist provider IDs/revisions and explicit source ownership. Test duplicate updates, cancellation, recurrence, expired sync tokens and renewal. Any two-way mode is separately specified and approved.

tasks.title: Add league administration and scoped staff roles
tasks.acceptance: Implement organization/season/division/team enrollment, delegated board/registrar/scheduler roles, team adoption and cross-tenant tests. Add venue constraints and human-approved schedule publication; retain independent teams.

tasks.title: Add registration, volunteers and screening status
tasks.acceptance: Provide accessible intake with family identity deduplication and approved forms; ingest only authorized website/provider integrations. Use external screening provider and restricted status/evidence, never autonomous background-check clearance.

tasks.title: Pilot parent-supervised practice and rewards
tasks.acceptance: Parent-managed player profile proposes a session; guardian approves the time and confirms completion; coach receives a digest; player earns a small private effort milestone. Test dual coach-parent identity and cross-team/household boundaries. Child-facing privacy/consent review precedes direct child use. No league entity, independent child account, public ranking or purchase requirement.

tasks.title: Validate adult equipment bundle commerce
tasks.acceptance: Validate coach demand, supplier margins, fulfillment/returns and payment flow before implementation; purchases cannot determine child rewards or participation.

tasks.title: Support coach and parent on one identity, plus co-coaches
tasks.acceptance: Introduce explicit team-scoped coach/co-coach capabilities and authorized delegation/revocation. An adult's guardian relationships remain usable alongside coaching powers, including on another team. Neither role switch nor possession of another team's ID escalates access. Test co-coach invitations and revoked access.

tasks.title: Publish coach-authored drills and team practice plans
tasks.acceptance: Coach and permitted co-coaches curate age-appropriate reviewed drills and licensed videos; publish a dated team plan; parent views appropriate instructions for their player. League approval is optional future policy, never an onboarding dependency. Test draft visibility, tenant isolation and revoked editor access.
tasks.code_areas: new practice plan/drill services and native screens

tasks.title: Prove independent-team tenancy and multi-team identity
tasks.acceptance: Exercise two independent teams and shared adult identities. Persist/validate team-season references; deny unauthorized roster, event, duty, message, file and future job targets. Do not require organizations to create teams. Brand/app-variant selection is presentation/distribution context, never membership authority.
tasks.code_areas: domain policy; all team-scoped routes and regression tests

tasks.title: Validate optional league-branded App Store distribution
tasks.acceptance: Only after successful team and league adoption: validate Apple's template/repetitive-app requirements and publisher model with a representative customized league app. Shared source/build manifest, per-app IDs/signing/APNs/links/privacy/releases, cross-publisher identity handling and server tenant policy are required. No cosmetic-reskin approval promise or per-league code fork; keep shared app fallback.
tasks.code_areas: future brand profile/app distribution manifest and native release matrix

product_focus: Coach, co-coaches, parents and players on an independent team first; league operations R4; branded apps last at R5.
